improvements: Formatting: the section headings ("The pain", "How we'll know it worked", "Detailed behavior", "Watch-outs", "Shipping it") are nonstandard, so the section checker reports every required section as missing even though the content is complete; renaming to Problem, Success metrics, Scope, Requirements, Risks and Rollout will help readers and tooling.
Requirements: specify code format and entropy (length, character set) and whether the user's session is re-verified before regenerating codes, pending Nadia's security review.

Edge cases: "After 5 failed recovery-code attempts the account locks for 30 minutes" could let an attacker lock out a user; clarify whether it locks the whole account or only recovery-code entry, and whether the user is notified.
Edge cases: cover what happens if 2FA is disabled and re-enabled (old codes invalidated?) and admin-forced 2FA resets.
Requirements: B4 email alert should state what it contains and how the user reports an unauthorized use.
Risks: the existing-2FA-user open question (Chris, Nov 8) is critical given the January 15 mandate; add a fallback if the security review (Nov 15) slips.
Rollout: add a rollback trigger (e.g., spike in failed setups or takeover alerts) and a post-launch monitoring owner.
questions: Will existing 2FA users, especially admins before January 15, be prompted or required to generate codes?
Does the 5-failure lockout apply to the whole account or just recovery-code entry?
What is the fallback for a user who has lost both their phone and their recovery codes?
